data.description: Strength training: the exercises you do and the machines you do them on, your workout routines, and the training sessions and sets Substrate Workouts logs. Needs the health catalogue.

One movement the owner trains, such as Chest Press (Machine): which numbers a set of it records, its equipment and muscles, its codes in other systems, and the settings Substrate Workouts's next-set suggestion reads.

name.description: the exercise's name as the owner reads it, such as Chest Press (Machine)

aliases.description: other names it is found by, such as RDL or the gym's name for the machine

measurement.description: which numbers a set of it records, which decides the set row's columns and how its load is read

equipment.description: what the load is moved with, which picks the default load step and base

laterality.description: whether it works both sides at once, one side at a time, or the sides in turn within a set; on the last two a set's reps count per side

loadBasis.description: what a logged load counts, the whole load, one implement such as one dumbbell, or one side of a machine

implements.description: how many implements a set holds, such as 2 for a pair of dumbbells; absent means one

primaryMuscles.description: the muscles it trains directly, each counting one set per set done

secondaryMuscles.description: the muscles it trains indirectly, each counting half a set per set done

restClass.description: the class that picks its default rest between sets when the routine names none

values.label: High-rep small muscles and trunk (1 min)

variationOf.description: the exercise this one is a variation of, such as the flat press for an incline press

codes.description: the same exercise in other systems' code sets, which an importer resolves it by

system.description: the code system, a URI where it has one or a word such as fit, hevy or strong

version.description: the code system's version, where it matters

display.description: the code system's own name for it

loadBase.description: the lightest load it can be set to, such as the empty bar; absent means the default for its equipment, else 0

loadStep.description: the smallest change of load, such as one pin or two of the smallest plates; its unit is the exercise's unit

loadMax.description: the heaviest load, or the most added load or assistance, it can be set to

bodyShare.description: the share of body mass a bodyweight set moves, from 0 to 1, such as 0.65 for a push-up; absent means 1; read only for the bodyweight measurements

defaultRepsMin.description: the fewest reps of the range a working set aims for when its routine names none

defaultRepsMax.description: the most reps of the range a working set aims for when its routine names none

defaultRPE.description: the effort a working set aims for when its routine names none, on the RIR-based RPE scale

repGain.description: the reps added per session at an unchanged load; absent means 1

dropPercent.description: how much lighter each drop of a drop set is, in percent; absent means 20

timeStep.description: the time added per session to a timed set at an unchanged load; absent means 5 seconds

myoStopRule.description: when a myo-rep set ends; absent means repdrop, the method's own rule

values.label: A mini-set loses a rep from the first
A mini-set falls below its target

myoMaxMiniSets.description: the most mini-sets after a myo activation set; absent means 5

data.description: One station an exercise is done on, such as the hotel gym's chest press machine: the exercise, where it is, and its own load grid. Sets done on it keep a history of their own.

name.description: the setup's name as the owner reads it, such as Chest Press (Machine), hotel gym

gym.description: where it is, such as Hotel gym

loadBase.description: the lightest load it can be set to here; absent means the exercise's

loadStep.description: the smallest change of load here, such as one pin; its unit is the setup's unit

loadMax.description: the heaviest load, or the most added load or assistance, it can be set to here

notes.description: what to remember about it, such as the seat height or which of two machines it is

data.description: A workout routine: the plan for one gym session, written in the console or by its agent. Ordered slots, one exercise each, hold planned sets with their targets and rests; groups bind slots into supersets and circuits. The Substrate Workouts app starts training sessions from it.

name.description: the routine's name, such as Day 1 – Strength Foundation

folder.description: the folder it is listed under, such as Full Body 3x Week (Back-Friendly)

position.description: its place in its folder, from 1

notes.description: what the routine is for and how to run it, shown before it starts

deload.description: true for a deload routine, whose sessions suggestions and trends discount

activityType.description: the Apple Health workout type its sessions are saved as, used only by the Health save; absent means traditional strength training

groups.description: the supersets, circuits and paired sets of the routine; a slot joins one by naming its key

key.description: the group's key within the routine, such as a, which its slots name in their group field

groupKind.description: what sort of group it is

pairing.description: how the members relate, which picks the default rest between them

rounds.description: how many rounds; absent means as many as the member with the most working sets, with warm-ups before round 1

roundRest.description: the rest after the last member of a round, before the next round starts

slots.description: the routine's exercises in order, each with its rests and planned sets

key.description: the slot's key within the routine, such as chest-press

exercise.description: the exercise done in this slot

group.description: the key of the group this slot is a member of; absent for a plain exercise

setRest.description: the rest between this slot's working sets; absent means the default for the exercise's rest class

warmupRest.description: the rest after one of this slot's warm-up sets; absent means 45 seconds

transition.description: in a group, the rest from this member to the next one in the same round

sideSwitch.description: for one side at a time, the pause between the sides of a set; absent means none

sideOrder.description: for one side at a time, which side goes first

sideMatch.description: true when the second side's target is the reps the first side did

notes.description: what to remember about this exercise in this routine, such as the seat height

sets.description: the sets planned for this slot, in order, warm-ups first

key.description: the planned set's key within the slot, such as w1 or s2, which a performed set names

roleLabel.description: for a working set, top set or back-off set

structure.description: how the set is built, from straight to a chain of drops or mini-sets

termination.description: what ends the set; absent means the reps or the time it names

repsMin.description: the fewest reps aimed for; equal to repsMax for an exact count

load.description: the load to start from, in the unit written; the added load on a bodyweight-plus exercise; wins over loadPercent when both are given

loadPercent.description: the load as a percentage of loadReference, such as 80; load wins when both are given

loadReference.description: what loadPercent is a percentage of

assistance.description: on an assisted exercise, the assistance to start from

rpeMin.description: the lowest effort aimed for on the RIR-based RPE scale; equal to rpeMax for one value, such as 8 for two reps left

rpeMax.description: the highest effort aimed for on the RIR-based RPE scale

rirMin.description: the fewest reps in reserve aimed for, where the routine says it that way; equal to rirMax for one value

rirMax.description: the most reps in reserve aimed for

durationMin.description: the shortest time aimed for in a timed set; equal to durationMax for an exact time

durationMax.description: the longest time aimed for in a timed set

timerMode.description: how the set's timer runs; absent means a countdown when a duration is set

distance.description: the distance aimed for, such as 20 m of a carry

tempo.description: the tempo to lift at, four phases eccentric first, such as 3-1-1-0

miniSetReps.description: the reps of each mini-set or cluster; absent means a quarter of the activation set's, from 3 to 5

miniSets.description: the most mini-sets after the first bout; for a cluster set, the clusters after the first

myoStopRule.description: when this myo-rep set ends, overriding the exercise's rule

values.label: A mini-set loses a rep from the first
A mini-set falls below its target

totalReps.description: the total reps that end a myo-rep or rest-pause set; for a myo-rep match, absent means the previous set's reps

drops.description: for a drop set, how many drops follow the first bout

dropPercent.description: how much lighter, in percent, each drop or a back-off set is than the set before

dropStep.description: how much lighter, as a load, each drop or a back-off set is than the set before

dropReps.description: the reps each drop aims for; absent means to failure

intraSetPause.description: the pause between the mini-sets, clusters or drops of this set

rest.description: the rest after this set, overriding the slot's or the group's

data.description: A training session: one visit to the gym as Substrate Workouts ran it, from a workout routine or from nothing. When it started and finished, the exercises in order and their supersets, and the Apple Health workout it was saved as. Its sets are records of their own.

name.description: the session's heading on the clock it was recorded on, such as Day 1 – Strength Foundation, Fri 30 Oct 13:42

status.description: active while it runs, then finished

routine.description: the workout routine it was started from; absent for a session started empty

routineVersion.description: the routine record's version when the session started

deload.description: true for a deload session, which suggestions and trends discount

sport.description: the sport, from the code set health/workout uses; Substrate Workouts writes strength

sportSource.description: the sport as an imported source named it, before mapping, such as FIT's training/strength_training; absent for a session logged in Substrate Workouts

activityType.description: the Apple Health workout type the session is saved as, used only by the Health save; absent means traditional strength training

slots.description: the session's exercises in the order shown; each set names its slot by key

key.description: the slot's key within the session, which its sets name

exercise.description: the exercise done in this slot

group.description: the key of the session group this slot is a member of

routineSlot.description: the key of the routine slot it came from; absent for an exercise added during the session

notes.description: what the owner noted about this exercise in this session

setRest.description: the rest between this slot's working sets, where the session set it

warmupRest.description: the rest after one of this slot's warm-up sets, where the session set it

transition.description: in a group, the rest from this member to the next one in the same round, where the session set it

sideSwitch.description: for one side at a time, the pause between the sides, where the session set it

sets.description: the planned sets of the routine slot as the session started with them, done or not, in order, warm-ups first

key.description: the planned set's key within the slot, such as w1 or s2, which a performed set names

roleLabel.description: for a working set, top set or back-off set

structure.description: how the set is built, from straight to a chain of drops or mini-sets

termination.description: what ends the set; absent means the reps or the time it names

repsMin.description: the fewest reps aimed for; equal to repsMax for an exact count

load.description: the load to start from, in the unit written; the added load on a bodyweight-plus exercise; wins over loadPercent when both are given

loadPercent.description: the load as a percentage of loadReference, such as 80; load wins when both are given

loadReference.description: what loadPercent is a percentage of

assistance.description: on an assisted exercise, the assistance to start from

rpeMin.description: the lowest effort aimed for on the RIR-based RPE scale; equal to rpeMax for one value, such as 8 for two reps left

rpeMax.description: the highest effort aimed for on the RIR-based RPE scale

rirMin.description: the fewest reps in reserve aimed for, where the routine says it that way; equal to rirMax for one value

rirMax.description: the most reps in reserve aimed for

durationMin.description: the shortest time aimed for in a timed set; equal to durationMax for an exact time

durationMax.description: the longest time aimed for in a timed set

timerMode.description: how the set's timer runs; absent means a countdown when a duration is set

distance.description: the distance aimed for, such as 20 m of a carry

tempo.description: the tempo to lift at, four phases eccentric first, such as 3-1-1-0

miniSetReps.description: the reps of each mini-set or cluster; absent means a quarter of the activation set's, from 3 to 5

miniSets.description: the most mini-sets after the first bout; for a cluster set, the clusters after the first

myoStopRule.description: when this myo-rep set ends, overriding the exercise's rule

values.label: A mini-set loses a rep from the first
A mini-set falls below its target

totalReps.description: the total reps that end a myo-rep or rest-pause set; for a myo-rep match, absent means the previous set's reps

drops.description: for a drop set, how many drops follow the first bout

dropPercent.description: how much lighter, in percent, each drop or a back-off set is than the set before

dropStep.description: how much lighter, as a load, each drop or a back-off set is than the set before

dropReps.description: the reps each drop aims for; absent means to failure

intraSetPause.description: the pause between the mini-sets, clusters or drops of this set

rest.description: the rest after this set, overriding the slot's or the group's

groups.description: the supersets, circuits and paired sets of the session; a slot joins one by naming its key

key.description: the group's key within the session, which its slots name

groupKind.description: what sort of group it is

pairing.description: how the members relate, which picks the default rest between them

rounds.description: how many rounds, where the session set it; absent means as many as the member with the most working sets

roundRest.description: the rest after the last member of a round, where the session set it

pauses.description: the spans the session's clock was paused, which Apple Health gets as pause and resume events

end.description: when the session resumed; absent while it is paused

utcOffsetStart.description: minutes east of UTC when it began

utcOffsetEnd.description: minutes east of UTC when it ended

timezone.description: the IANA zone the session was recorded in, such as Europe/London

bodyMass.description: the owner's body mass on the day, which bodyweight and assisted sets are reckoned from

sessionRPE.description: how hard the whole session felt on the CR10 scale, 0 to 10, if the owner rated it at Finish

notes.description: anything worth saying about the session

healthKitWorkout.description: the UUID of the Apple Health workout the session was saved as, in HealthKit's uppercase spelling

workout.description: the health workout built from that Apple Health workout, at applehealth/<account>/<UUID>, where the account is Substrate Sync's for the phone

source.description: the app or device it was logged with, such as Substrate Workouts or an imported Hevy history

about.description: who trained; absent means the repository's owner

origin.description: the record an importer built this from, such as a Hevy workout; absent for a session logged in Substrate Workouts

revision.description: rises with each change the writer sends; a lower one is refused

adapter.description: what wrote it and its version, `<name>@<version>`, such as substrate-workouts@1.0.0

data.description: One set the owner performed in a training session: the exercise, the load in the unit used and what it counts, the reps or time, the effort and how it was given, the rest before it, and the targets it was done against. A drop, a myo mini-set or one side is a record of its own, chained to the set it continues.

session.description: the training session the set was done in

exercise.description: the exercise the set was done on

slot.description: the key of the session slot the set belongs to

order.description: the set's row in its slot, from 1, warm-ups first and a chain's records in turn

ordinal.description: its number among the slot's sets of the same role, a chain counted once, such as working set 2

setup.description: the station it was done on, such as the hotel gym's chest press; sets with different setups keep separate history

roleLabel.description: for a working set, top set or back-off set

structure.description: how the set is built, the same on every record of a chain

continues.description: the first set of the chain this one continues, such as the working set before a drop; absent on a chain's head

chainPosition.description: its place in its chain, 1 for the head, 2 for the first drop, mini-set or second side

side.description: the side done, when one side at a time is logged as two records

loadMode.description: how the load reads, an external load, bodyweight alone, bodyweight plus the load, or bodyweight less the assistance; absent when the exercise moves no load

load.description: the load in the unit it was entered in, as loadBasis counts it; the added load on bodyweight plus

assistance.description: on an assisted exercise, the assistance used, as a positive amount

resistanceLabel.description: the resistance as the equipment labels it when it is not a load, such as a red band or level 7

reps.description: the reps completed, not counting a failed attempt, as repsBasis counts them

duration.description: the time a timed set lasted, past its target if the owner kept going

distance.description: how far, such as the length of a carry

loadBasis.description: what the load counts, the whole load, one implement such as one dumbbell, or one side of a machine, as the exercise said when the set was logged

implements.description: how many implements the set held, such as 2 for a pair of dumbbells, as the exercise said when the set was logged

bodyShare.description: the share of body mass the set moved, from 0 to 1, as the exercise said when the set was logged; on the bodyweight modes only

laterality.description: whether the exercise worked both sides at once, one side at a time, or the sides in turn, when the set was logged

repsBasis.description: whether reps counts both sides together or one side's reps; Substrate Workouts counts per side on unilateral and alternating work

rpe.description: the effort the set was logged with, on the scale rpeScale names

rpeMethod.description: how rpe got its value, written whenever rpe is; a reader takes only an entered or imported rpe as a rating

values.label: Pre-filled from the plan and logged unchanged

rir.description: the reps in reserve as a source logged them, never derived from rpe

rirMethod.description: how rir got its value, written whenever rir is, with the same rules as rpeMethod

values.label: Pre-filled from the plan and logged unchanged

rpeScale.description: the scale rpe and the target's effort are on; Substrate Workouts writes rirbased; absent reads as rirbased

reachedFailure.description: true when the set ended because another full rep was not possible

failedRepAttempted.description: true when a further rep was tried and missed, as Strong's Failure tag means

completionMethod.description: how the set was completed, ticked on its own, marked done with the other unticked rows at Finish, or imported

notes.description: what the owner noted about this set, such as two partial reps at the end

sourceType.description: an imported set's type as its source wrote it, such as Hevy's dropset; absent for a set logged in Substrate Workouts

timeBasis.description: what at is, the instant the set was completed, a time of its session's standing in for one nobody recorded, or an estimate

startedAt.description: when the set began, where it is known, such as a timed set's start

restBefore.description: the rest actually taken before this set, from the end of the set before

restMethod.description: how restBefore was measured, to this set's recorded start, to the end of the rest on the device, as a source recorded it, or estimated

values.label: To the end of the rest on the device

restPlanned.description: the rest prescribed before this set, as the timer counted it down

restSkipped.description: true when the owner skipped the rest before this set

target.description: the planned set this set fulfils and its targets as they stood; absent for an added set

plannedSet.description: the key of the planned set it fulfils, such as s2

termination.description: what was to end the set

load.description: the planned load as an absolute load, resolved from a percentage where the plan gave one, before any suggestion

loadPercent.description: the planned load as a percentage of loadReference, where the plan gave it that way

loadReference.description: what loadPercent was a percentage of

referenceLoad.description: the reference load the percentage was taken of, as it stood, such as a 120 kg training max

assistance.description: the planned assistance on an assisted exercise

rpeMin.description: the lowest effort aimed for, on the scale rpeScale names; equal to rpeMax for one value

rirMin.description: the fewest reps in reserve aimed for; equal to rirMax for one value

rirMax.description: the most reps in reserve aimed for

tempo.description: the tempo to lift at, four phases eccentric first, such as 3-1-1-0

miniSetReps.description: the reps aimed for in each mini-set or cluster

miniSets.description: the most mini-sets or clusters after the first bout

myoStopRule.description: when the myo-rep set was to end

values.label: A mini-set loses a rep from the first
A mini-set falls below its target

totalReps.description: the total reps that were to end a myo-rep or rest-pause set

drops.description: how many drops were to follow the first bout

dropPercent.description: how much lighter, in percent, each drop or a back-off set was to be

dropStep.description: how much lighter each drop or a back-off set was to be, as a load

dropReps.description: the reps each drop aimed for; absent means to failure

intraSetPause.description: the pause between the mini-sets, clusters or drops of the set

origin.description: the record an importer built this from, such as a Hevy workout; absent for a set logged in Substrate Workouts

revision.description: rises with each change the writer sends; a lower one is refused
